title: Avoid duplicate canonical prerequisite validation in ordinary single-item updates
outcome: Avoid duplicate canonical prerequisite validation in ordinary single-item updates
acceptance: A normal prerequisite addition verifies the prior canonical edge set once while preserving corrupt-edge refusal and the same relation fingerprint

completion.summary: An ordinary prerequisite add or remove validates the item's relation basis once and hands it to its own append (CheckedRelationBasis with private fields; append_checked_relation_event refuses another item or transition). Corrupt-edge refusal and the recorded relation fingerprint are unchanged, with tests for one validation per add/no-op/removal, the independently built fingerprint, and refusal with nothing written on extra and dropped edges.
